scripts.cert:generate: npm run cert:prepare && openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 825 -keyout cert/localhost-key.pem -out cert/localhost-cert.pem -subj "/C=US/ST=Local/L=Local/O=Peripheral/CN=localhost" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev: npm run cert:generate && npm run dev:https
